{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

#FLUX: --ntasks=1
#FLUX: --queue=priority
#FLUX: --time=2-00:00:00

# The Slurm directive '--mem 4G' does not have a direct equivalent in Flux and has been omitted.
# The performance implication is that the job may be scheduled on a node without enough memory, potentially causing it to fail.

#FLUX: --output=logs/rc-nonallelespec/snakemake_%J.log
#FLUX: --error=logs/rc-nonallelespec/snakemake_%J.log

module unload python
module load gcc conda2 slurm-drmaa/1.1.1
conda activate rctest

# The Snakemake '--drmaa' flag is specific to schedulers with a DRMAA interface like Slurm.
# It has been replaced with the more general '--cluster' flag, and the submission command has been adapted for 'flux mini submit'.
# Note: The '{cluster.mem}' parameter from the original submission string has been omitted as Flux does not have a standard memory request directive.
# This might cause individual sub-jobs to be scheduled on nodes without enough memory, potentially leading to failure.
flux_submit_args='flux mini submit --cpus-per-task={cluster.cores} --queue={cluster.partition} --time={cluster.time} --output={cluster.out} --error={cluster.err} --job-name={cluster.J}'

snakemake \
  --snakefile src/20_62_nonallelespec_rc-test-Snakefile.py \
  --jobs 9980 \
  --restart-times 0 \
  --cluster-config config/rc-test-snakemake-cluster.json \
  --latency-wait 120 \
  --cluster "$flux_submit_args"

conda deactivate
"
}

# The Snakemake '--drmaa' flag is specific to schedulers with a DRMAA interface like Slurm.
# It has been replaced with the more general '--cluster' flag, and the submission command has been adapted for 'flux mini submit'.
# Note: The '{cluster.mem}' parameter from the original submission string has been omitted as Flux does not have a standard memory request directive.
# This might cause individual sub-jobs to be scheduled on nodes without enough memory, potentially leading to failure.
flux_submit_args='flux mini submit --cpus-per-task={cluster.cores} --queue={cluster.partition} --time={cluster.time} --output={cluster.out} --error={cluster.err} --job-name={cluster.J}'

snakemake \
  --snakefile src/20_62_nonallelespec_rc-test-Snakefile.py \
  --jobs 9980 \
  --restart-times 0 \
  --cluster-config config/rc-test-snakemake-cluster.json \
  --latency-wait 120 \
  --cluster "$flux_submit_args"

conda deactivate

inputs.script:
#!/bin/bash

#SBATCH -c 1
#SBATCH -p priority
#SBATCH -t 2-00:00
#SBATCH --mem 4G
#SBATCH -o logs/rc-nonallelespec/snakemake_%A.log
#SBATCH -e logs/rc-nonallelespec/snakemake_%A.log

module unload python
module load gcc conda2 slurm-drmaa/1.1.1
conda activate rctest


snakemake \
  --snakefile src/20_62_nonallelespec_rc-test-Snakefile.py \
  --jobs 9980 \
  --restart-times 0 \
  --cluster-config config/rc-test-snakemake-cluster.json \
  --latency-wait 120 \
  --drmaa " -c {cluster.cores} -p {cluster.partition} --mem={cluster.mem} -t {cluster.time} -o {cluster.out} -e {cluster.err} -J {cluster.J}"

conda deactivate
